title: FairMean: Promoting Fairness in Distributed Learning under Label Poisoning Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2609.26377v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fairness-aware distributed learning prioritizes clients with large losses to reduce performance disparities, but label poisoning can create large losses, thereby inducing a fairness--robustness conflict. We propose FairMean to manage this conflict. FairMean weights client gradients using a bounded, nondecreasing function of local loss. The increasing weights prioritize high-loss clients to promote fairness, while the upper bound prevents excessive loss-induced amplification of poisoned-client gradients. In the absence of label poisoning, we show that minimizing the FairMean objective is more conducive to solution fairness than minimizing the standard average-loss objective. Under label poisoning, we establish an average-stationarity bound whose attack-dependent term is proportional to the square of the poisoned-client fraction. Experiments show that FairMean promotes fairness by reducing accuracy variance while improving worst-client acc

translated_title: FairMean：在标签投毒攻击下促进分布式学习中的公平性
translated_abstract: 公平感知的分布式学习会优先考虑损失较大的客户端，以减少性能差异，但标签投毒攻击可以制造较大的损失，从而引发公平性与鲁棒性之间的冲突。我们提出FairMean来管理这一冲突。FairMean使用局部损失的有界非递减函数为客户端梯度加权。递增的权重优先照顾高损失客户端以促进公平性，而其上限则防止因损失过大导致投毒客户端的梯度被过度放大。在没有标签投毒的情况下，我们证明最小化FairMean目标比最小化标准平均损失目标更有利于解的公平性。在存在标签投毒的情况下，我们建立了一个平均平稳性界，其中与攻击相关的项与投毒客户端比例的平方成正比。实验表明，FairMean通过降低准确率方差来促进公平性，同时提高了最差客户端的准确率。
tldr: FairMean通过对客户端梯度采用局部损失的有界非递减函数进行加权，在标签投毒攻击下化解公平性与鲁棒性的冲突，既优先帮助高损失客户端以促进公平，又通过权重上限防止投毒客户端的梯度被过度放大。
en_tdlr: FairMean resolves the fairness-robustness conflict under label poisoning attacks by weighting client gradients with a bounded, nondecreasing function of local loss, prioritizing high-loss clients for fairness while the weight bound prevents excessive amplification of poisoned-client gradients.
